parameters.name: $filter
parameters.value: =CUSTOMERPRICEGROUP eq 'STANDARD' and CONDITIONVALIDITYSTARTDATE le '{{ $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd') }}' and CONDITIONVALIDITYENDDATE ge '{{ $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd') }}'

parameters.query: SELECT material AS "MATERIAL", description AS "DESCRIPTION", material_type AS "MATERIAL_TYPE", material_group AS "MATERIAL_GROUP", plant AS "PLANT", family AS "FAMILY", mgd2 AS "MGD2", upc AS "UPC" FROM materials WHERE material_type != 'ROH'
